name: PrimeBOT Q1
price_note: 19,999 yuan (≈US$2.8k) base; Q1 Explorer with open dev interfaces 26,999 yuan
summary: An 88 cm personal humanoid shown at IFA 2026 and put on sale in China in September 2026, with deliveries from October. PrimeBOT bets on customization and an app store: owners can change its appearance, voice, personality and behaviors.
